en: Leviticus 24

p.src: 1  The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
u.src: 1  The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

p.src: 2  “Command the children of Israel, that they bring to you pure olive oil beaten for the light, to cause a lamp to burn continually.

en: “Command the children of Israel, that they bring to you pure olive oil beaten for the light, to cause a lamp to burn continually.
u.src: 2  “Command the children of Israel, that they bring to you pure olive oil beaten for the light, to cause a lamp to burn continually.

p.src: 3  Outside of the veil of the Testimony, in the Tent of Meeting, Aaron shall keep it in order from evening to morning before the LORD continually. It shall be a statute forever throughout your generations.

en: Outside of the veil of the Testimony, in the Tent of Meeting, Aaron shall keep it in order from evening to morning before the LORD continually. It shall be a statute forever throughout your generations.
u.src: 3  Outside of the veil of the Testimony, in the Tent of Meeting, Aaron shall keep it in order from evening to morning before the LORD continually. It shall be a statute forever throughout your generations.

p.src: 4  He shall keep in order the lamps on the pure gold lamp stand before the LORD continually.

en: He shall keep in order the lamps on the pure gold lamp stand before the LORD continually.
u.src: 4  He shall keep in order the lamps on the pure gold lamp stand before the LORD continually.

p.src: 5  “You shall take fine flour, and bake twelve cakes of it: two tenths of an ephah shall be in one cake.

en: “You shall take fine flour, and bake twelve cakes of it: two tenths of an ephah shall be in one cake.
u.src: 5  “You shall take fine flour, and bake twelve cakes of it: two tenths of an ephah shall be in one cake.

en: 24:5 1 ephah is about 22 liters or about 2/3 of a bushel

p.src: 6  You shall set them in two rows, six on a row, on the pure gold table before the LORD.

en: You shall set them in two rows, six on a row, on the pure gold table before the LORD.
u.src: 6  You shall set them in two rows, six on a row, on the pure gold table before the LORD.

p.src: 7  You shall put pure frankincense on each row, that it may be to the bread for a memorial, even an offering made by fire to the LORD.

en: You shall put pure frankincense on each row, that it may be to the bread for a memorial, even an offering made by fire to the LORD.
u.src: 7  You shall put pure frankincense on each row, that it may be to the bread for a memorial, even an offering made by fire to the LORD.

p.src: 8  Every Sabbath day he shall set it in order before the LORD continually. It is an everlasting covenant on the behalf of the children of Israel.

en: Every Sabbath day he shall set it in order before the LORD continually. It is an everlasting covenant on the behalf of the children of Israel.
u.src: 8  Every Sabbath day he shall set it in order before the LORD continually. It is an everlasting covenant on the behalf of the children of Israel.

p.src: 9  It shall be for Aaron and his sons. They shall eat it in a holy place; for it is most holy to him of the offerings of the LORD made by fire by a perpetual statute.”

en: It shall be for Aaron and his sons. They shall eat it in a holy place; for it is most holy to him of the offerings of the LORD made by fire by a perpetual statute.”
u.src: 9  It shall be for Aaron and his sons. They shall eat it in a holy place; for it is most holy to him of the offerings of the LORD made by fire by a perpetual statute.”

p.src: 10  The son of an Israelite woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel; and the son of the Israelite woman and a man of Israel strove together in the camp.

en: The son of an Israelite woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel; and the son of the Israelite woman and a man of Israel strove together in the camp.
u.src: 10  The son of an Israelite woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel; and the son of the Israelite woman and a man of Israel strove together in the camp.

p.src: 11  The son of the Israelite woman blasphemed the Name, and cursed; and they brought him to Moses. His mother’s name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan.

en: The son of the Israelite woman blasphemed the Name, and cursed; and they brought him to Moses. His mother’s name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan.
u.src: 11  The son of the Israelite woman blasphemed the Name, and cursed; and they brought him to Moses. His mother’s name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan.

p.src: 12  They put him in custody until the LORD’s will should be declared to them.

en: They put him in custody until the LORD’s will should be declared to them.
u.src: 12  They put him in custody until the LORD’s will should be declared to them.

p.src: 13  The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
u.src: 13  The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

p.src: 14  “Bring him who cursed out of the camp; and let all who heard him lay their hands on his head, and let all the congregation stone him.

en: “Bring him who cursed out of the camp; and let all who heard him lay their hands on his head, and let all the congregation stone him.
u.src: 14  “Bring him who cursed out of the camp; and let all who heard him lay their hands on his head, and let all the congregation stone him.

p.src: 15  You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Whoever curses his God shall bear his sin.

en: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Whoever curses his God shall bear his sin.
u.src: 15  You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Whoever curses his God shall bear his sin.

p.src: 16  He who blasphemes the LORD’s name, he shall surely be put to death. All the congregation shall certainly stone him. The foreigner as well as the native-born shall be put to death when he blasphemes the Name.

en: He who blasphemes the LORD’s name, he shall surely be put to death. All the congregation shall certainly stone him. The foreigner as well as the native-born shall be put to death when he blasphemes the Name.
u.src: 16  He who blasphemes the LORD’s name, he shall surely be put to death. All the congregation shall certainly stone him. The foreigner as well as the native-born shall be put to death when he blasphemes the Name.

p.src: 17  “‘He who strikes any man mortally shall surely be put to death.

en: “‘He who strikes any man mortally shall surely be put to death.
u.src: 17  “‘He who strikes any man mortally shall surely be put to death.

p.src: 18  He who strikes an animal mortally shall make it good, life for life.

en: He who strikes an animal mortally shall make it good, life for life.
u.src: 18  He who strikes an animal mortally shall make it good, life for life.

p.src: 19  If anyone injures his neighbor, it shall be done to him as he has done:

en: If anyone injures his neighbor, it shall be done to him as he has done:
u.src: 19  If anyone injures his neighbor, it shall be done to him as he has done:

p.src: 20  fracture for fracture, eye for eye, tooth for tooth. It shall be done to him as he has injured someone.

en: fracture for fracture, eye for eye, tooth for tooth. It shall be done to him as he has injured someone.
u.src: 20  fracture for fracture, eye for eye, tooth for tooth. It shall be done to him as he has injured someone.

p.src: 21  He who kills an animal shall make it good; and he who kills a man shall be put to death.

en: He who kills an animal shall make it good; and he who kills a man shall be put to death.
u.src: 21  He who kills an animal shall make it good; and he who kills a man shall be put to death.

p.src: 22  You shall have one kind of law for the foreigner as well as the native-born; for I am the LORD your God.’”

en: You shall have one kind of law for the foreigner as well as the native-born; for I am the LORD your God.’”
u.src: 22  You shall have one kind of law for the foreigner as well as the native-born; for I am the LORD your God.’”

p.src: 23  Moses spoke to the children of Israel; and they brought him who had cursed out of the camp, and stoned him with stones. The children of Israel did as the LORD commanded Moses.

en: Moses spoke to the children of Israel; and they brought him who had cursed out of the camp, and stoned him with stones. The children of Israel did as the LORD commanded Moses.
u.src: 23  Moses spoke to the children of Israel; and they brought him who had cursed out of the camp, and stoned him with stones. The children of Israel did as the LORD commanded Moses.
